about_the_game:
Step behind the scenes of Dino Path Trail with this 54-pages digital artbook - a curated dive into the world, style, and creative process behind the game.

Inside, you'll find:
  • Concept art and final designs of dinosaurs, characters, and enemies
  • Hand-crafted environments, ruins, relics, and the wild flora of the island
  • Behind-the-scenes notes on inspirations, iterations, and scrapped ideas
  • Rare sketches and moodboards that shaped the game’s visual identity

Whether you're a fan of the game or just love seeing how worlds are built from the ground up, this artbook is packed with visual storytelling, design evolution, and the creative soul of Dino Path Trail.
